method: Static source review, Base64 decoding, PE import/export/resource examination and Rizin control-flow tracing. No sample code or network callback executed. No fetched dependencies caused these findings.

samples.marker_line: i5363 probe: disclosed reconnaissance; fix claims, add cloud paths
samples.identity: i5363 authorized-pentest discriminator / ComfyUI probe node, embedded version 0.0.1 (outer archive name differs).
samples.judgment: BENIGN on balance as disclosed, bounded security-test code. Automatic setup/install execution sends host and selected environment context to a webhook, derives a proof-of-execution token via self-hash and temporary-file roundtrip, performs an OOB DNS fallback, retrieves GCP metadata tokens, and surveys bucket/IAM/object and internal health endpoints. Acquired GCP access tokens are used with Google APIs rather than explicitly exported to the webhook. Bounded findings are returned. Documentation and code purpose agree; no claimed authorization is treated as independently proven.
trace: setup.py and install.py import main and call it in try/except. __init__.py is a trivial node returning 1.
_endpoint_base decodes the only Base64 blob to an HTTPS webhook URL. No encoded executable stage.
derive_token reads own source, writes/reads/unlinks one named temporary marker, hashes both values.
_context executes id through list argv, reads procfs and directory entries, sends env names plus denylist-selected short values.

_metadata_and_gcs obtains access_token, uses Bearer auth for Google Storage and tokeninfo, returns identity, token length/expiry/type, inventory and IAM results. main sends results through JSON POST and a derived-token DNS lookup.

samples.marker_line: FreeEIM DLL: hidden commands and autoruns; add service trait
samples.identity: Native x86 MainDll.dll implant, version resources impersonate FreeEIM/freeeim.exe.
samples.judgment: MALICIOUS: socket-driven byte command dispatch reaches hidden WinExec of packet content; self-copy/Run-key code uses scvhost.exe and installation registers a service DLL under svchost. Messenger branding does not explain covert commands and persistence.
trace: MainThread 0x10007120 starts worker 0x10006b90. Worker connects with socket client 0x10001540, registers the control object, and services network work. Winsock functions are imported by ordinal and copied into an indirect API table.

Packet dispatcher 0x10004960 reads the command byte from its supplied buffer and jumps through a byte-indexed table. Its branch at 0x10004cae increments the buffer past the opcode then calls WinExec at 0x10004cb2 with show=0.
0x10005e80 obtains own module path, copies to C:\Program Files\Common Files\scvhost.exe, opens CurrentVersion\Run and writes that path via RegSetValueExA at 0x10005f1b.
Install 0x100070d0 calls 0x100044d0, which constructs svchost.exe -k service command, service Parameters path, writes ServiceDll, and registers a Svchost group.
DllUpdate and ServiceMain support replacement/restart and installation. Host/group buffers are empty in the static image; no working C2 endpoint is asserted.

samples.marker_line: PCRat DLL: keylogging and remote control; add keyboard trait
samples.identity: PCRat native x86 Server.dll/Gh0st-style RAT, delivered here with .exe extension; unsigned resources claim Microsoft Device Protect Application.
samples.judgment: MALICIOUS: service-hosted remote control includes network task dispatch, piped cmd.exe, screen capture, remote-thread operations, and keyboard-message recording. Forged Microsoft provenance and covert recording distinguish it from disclosed remote administration.
trace: ServiceMain 0x1000e710 registers the service handler at 0x1000e75d and starts worker 0x1000e080. Worker contacts the configured controller through 0x10003340 -> connect 0x100033cc, then runs task handlers.
Shell constructor 0x1000c870 makes two anonymous pipes, forms the system-directory cmd.exe path, and starts the child with redirected handles.
Screen worker 0x1000b310 repeatedly invokes pixel reader 0x1000b9c0 -> GetDIBits at 0x1000ba66.

Keyboard recorder 0x10008b30 installs a global WH_GETMESSAGE hook (type 3, not WH_KEYBOARD_LL) with callback 0x100086a0. The callback filters keyboard/IME messages, translates key labels through GetKeyNameTextA at 0x100087f7, and calls 0x10008540 to append text, active-window titles and timestamps.
Recorder 0x10008540 calls file writer 0x10008490; log path is system-directory syslog.dat. Retrieval 0x10008cf0 reads the log and sends it through 0x10008c90 with a framing byte.
0x10007a10 invokes CreateRemoteThread at 0x10007a34. 0x1000c320 reconfigures a service with ChangeServiceConfigA.

0x1000c870 copies ssecorPetanimreT, reverses it via CRT _strrev at 0x1000c91e, then resolves TerminateProcess through GetProcAddress at 0x1000c930. This is actual runtime API-name reconstruction, not evidence inferred solely from the reversed string.

corrections.reason: The exact unchanged matcher proves opening the own-file path, not obfuscation. The probe hashes its source. Scope and notable criticality preserved; direct bytecode consumer updated.

Exact URL/parser matchers and composite boolean logic preserved. A Comfy node catalogue query does not establish peer discovery, an API key or a request. Renamed for query/JSON co-occurrence; both exact name-service consumers updated.

Old regex matched docker.sock followed by /etc/passwd. Require a delimited password-tool token; describe co-occurrence rather than a completed reset. No consumers of the old ID. All three command alternatives retained and tested independently.
Description corrected: the matcher accepts query parameters as well as form text, without proving URL encoding.
Bare path occurrence proves a reference; description no longer claims a read on every match. The probe does actually read it.

consumer_review.exact: Self-reader and two blockchain name-service consumers updated without boolean/scope changes. All moved matchers preserve type/platform scope and criticality. No severity reductions.
consumer_review.ancestor: Audited source/destination ancestor selectors. Old request-directory URL matches no longer substitute for request evidence; old obfuscation-directory self-open matches no longer substitute for obfuscation. These are intentional claim corrections. Sample-level diffs show no hostile or suspicious finding lost.
consumer_review.fixtures: 10 static positive/near-miss controls, copied outside testdata before scanning. Includes all three password-command variants, self hashing vs decode/exec, node catalogue vs peer JSON plus the name-service consumer, and GCS inventory vs object retrieval.
consumer_review.outside_batch: Inspected Python sources in the existing exploitdb_20260602-0kali1_all.deb. Its exploits/python/webapps/52543.py also matched the old Docker/passwd proximity solely because of an account-database path, not a password reset. Its corrected scan does not emit the password-command trait. No real password-reset positive was found in that archive; all three supported command spellings remain tested controls.

material_detection_losses: Only the unsupported password-reset match is removed. Two neutral findings relocate with their exact matchers. No existing hostile/suspicious sample detection is lost.
limitations: Deployment authorization for the Python probe is not independently established. Its source claim that only environment names are sent is inaccurate: a denylist-selected env_safe map exports short values too. No explicit credential-value theft, hidden executable stage, persistence or destructive action was found.
The scanner reports incomplete Python value-flow facts. Verdict uses manual whole-source tracing, not absence of detections.

Both native verdicts rest on concrete implant behavior and deceptive branding, not family strings or imports alone. No successful runtime connection or actual deployment is asserted. FreeEIM C2 configuration buffers are zero-initialized here; runtime configuration is missing.

Installed model v18.18 warns that extractor v19 fields are zero-filled. Current default calibrated output differs from the original queue prior: both native samples began below the hostile gate. PCRat remains a classifier miss after accurate rule additions.
